acceptedInterpretation: B-9fc5 delivers a detailed execution plan for Parent Roadmap Completion Gate / User Intent Totality Gate. It must make Red/Repro tests the first implementation milestone, define the full parent-child totality contract and implementation milestones, and bind the plan to B-5082 controls. It must not claim runtime gate implementation or full M4-M12 roadmap completion.
notes: This resolves the ambiguity between planning the gate and implementing the gate. Runtime implementation must be a later story whose first milestone is red/repro test creation.
